units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|The gloomy feel of the local spaceport appears to be somehow even more pronounced today. Very few Korath are doing anything but the most basic maintenance of the local facilities, as if they all had their attention elsewhere. It doesn't take you long to notice the gathering of a considerable number of Korath by one large, blackened side of an abandoned building, which seems to be the reason for the drop in the local morale.|26|0
units.english: The gloomy feel of the local spaceport appears to be somehow even more pronounced today. Very few Korath are doing anything but the most basic maintenance of the local facilities, as if they all had their attention elsewhere. It doesn't take you long to notice the gathering of a considerable number of Korath by one large, blackened side of an abandoned building, which seems to be the reason for the drop in the local morale.
units.italian: L'atmosfera cupa dello spazioporto locale oggi sembra in qualche modo ancora più marcata. Pochissimi Korath fanno qualcosa oltre alla manutenzione più elementare delle strutture, come se avessero tutti l'attenzione altrove. Non ti serve molto per notare un gruppo consistente di Korath radunato accanto a un grande lato annerito di un edificio abbandonato: sembra essere questo il motivo del calo del morale.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	As you approach the group, you notice a few Korath children running their hands over the dark wall, scratching it carefully with what must be something akin to crayons, or some material that could perform the same function. After they play around for a while, you notice all their drawings seem to take a similar shape: a beige or brownish circle, with some shy spots of blue, and rare bits of green. Contrasted by the onyx background of the building wall, you easily make it out to be a planet.|27|0
units.english: As you approach the group, you notice a few Korath children running their hands over the dark wall, scratching it carefully with what must be something akin to crayons, or some material that could perform the same function. After they play around for a while, you notice all their drawings seem to take a similar shape: a beige or brownish circle, with some shy spots of blue, and rare bits of green. Contrasted by the onyx background of the building wall, you easily make it out to be a planet.
units.italian: Avvicinandoti al gruppo, noti alcuni bambini Korath che passano le mani sul muro scuro, incidendolo con cura con qualcosa di simile a pastelli, o a un materiale che può svolgere la stessa funzione. Dopo che hanno giocato un po', noti che tutti i loro disegni prendono una forma simile: un cerchio beige o brunastro, con qualche timida macchia di blu e rari tocchi di verde. Sul fondo di onice del muro dell'edificio, riconosci facilmente in tutto ciò un pianeta.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	Up close, you see many adult and elderly Korath, gathered as if in a prayer group around a shrine of sorts, just a few steps away from the building. They are mostly silent but for a few brief gasps. The shrine seems to be simply a pile of common crates and boxes, hidden by a dusty canvas that's not large enough to cover all of the cubic components of the pyramid-like structure.|28|0
units.english: Up close, you see many adult and elderly Korath, gathered as if in a prayer group around a shrine of sorts, just a few steps away from the building. They are mostly silent but for a few brief gasps. The shrine seems to be simply a pile of common crates and boxes, hidden by a dusty canvas that's not large enough to cover all of the cubic components of the pyramid-like structure.
units.italian: Da vicino vedi molti Korath adulti e anziani, raccolti come in un gruppo di preghiera attorno a una sorta di santuario, a pochi passi dall'edificio. Sono per lo più silenziosi, a parte qualche breve sospiro. Il santuario sembra semplicemente un mucchio di casse e scatole comuni, nascosto da una tela impolverata che non basta a coprire tutte le componenti cubiche della struttura piramidale.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	At the bottom of the shrine, the Korath seem to have deposited a plethora of personal belongings - clothing pieces, tools, pictures and coins, books and crystals, large fragments of cracked eggshells, flasks of oils or other substances, small jewelry pieces, and all manner of beads. The items seem to pile on and on endlessly, as every passing Korath in the spaceport makes a point to pass by the shrine and leave something as an offering.|29|0
units.english: At the bottom of the shrine, the Korath seem to have deposited a plethora of personal belongings - clothing pieces, tools, pictures and coins, books and crystals, large fragments of cracked eggshells, flasks of oils or other substances, small jewelry pieces, and all manner of beads. The items seem to pile on and on endlessly, as every passing Korath in the spaceport makes a point to pass by the shrine and leave something as an offering.
units.italian: Alla base del santuario i Korath sembrano aver deposto una miriade di oggetti personali - capi di vestiario, attrezzi, fotografie e monete, libri e cristalli, grandi frammenti di gusci d'uovo incrinati, fiale di oli o altre sostanze, piccoli gioielli e perline di ogni tipo. Gli oggetti sembrano accumularsi senza fine, perché ogni Korath che passa nello spazioporto si fa un punto di passare dal santuario e lasciare qualcosa come offerta.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	On the first level of crates, you first see a number of wooden, stone, and metal slabs, with various scratch marks over them. Upon closer inspection, you see that from certain angles, the marks combine to form shapes like those of the planet drawn by the children. The marks also form many other planets, with clearly defined oceans and continents. There are stars, systems, symbols you can't recognize, and a great number of tablets with nothing but writing.|30|0
units.english: On the first level of crates, you first see a number of wooden, stone, and metal slabs, with various scratch marks over them. Upon closer inspection, you see that from certain angles, the marks combine to form shapes like those of the planet drawn by the children. The marks also form many other planets, with clearly defined oceans and continents. There are stars, systems, symbols you can't recognize, and a great number of tablets with nothing but writing.
units.italian: Sul primo livello di casse vedi dapprima una serie di lastre di legno, pietra e metallo, coperte di vari segni incisi. Guardando meglio, noti che da certi angoli i segni si combinano in forme simili a quelle del pianeta disegnato dai bambini. I segni formano anche molti altri pianeti, con oceani e continenti ben definiti. Ci sono stelle, sistemi, simboli che non riconosci e un gran numero di tavolette coperte solo di scrittura.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	One of the oldest Korath in the gathering, who had been shivering with his head in his hands since before you approached, lets out an agonizing, bark-like yelp in a frayed voice. He looks up to the top of the shrine. Standing at navel height, one lone crate supports only a few items. A large, colorful feather, an amazingly complex seashell, and a mysteriously beautiful flower sit on the top crate, all surrounding one single, lone candle, which looks as if it's been burning for hours on end.|31|0
units.english: One of the oldest Korath in the gathering, who had been shivering with his head in his hands since before you approached, lets out an agonizing, bark-like yelp in a frayed voice. He looks up to the top of the shrine. Standing at navel height, one lone crate supports only a few items. A large, colorful feather, an amazingly complex seashell, and a mysteriously beautiful flower sit on the top crate, all surrounding one single, lone candle, which looks as if it's been burning for hours on end.
units.italian: Uno dei Korath più anziani del gruppo, che tremava con la testa fra le mani da prima che ti avvicinassi, emette un guaito agonizzante, simile a un latrato, con una voce roca. Alza lo sguardo verso la cima del santuario. A un'altezza da ombelico, una sola cassa regge appena pochi oggetti. Una grande piuma variopinta, una conchiglia straordinariamente complessa e un fiore di misteriosa bellezza stanno sulla cassa più alta, tutti attorno a una singola candela solitaria, che sembra ardere da ore e ore.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	You wonder how this one candle could be burning for so long out in the open, and think that perhaps the Korath simply relight it whenever it is put out by a passing gust. Only at that thought do you notice that, today, there is no wind whatsoever on <origin>.|32|0
units.english: You wonder how this one candle could be burning for so long out in the open, and think that perhaps the Korath simply relight it whenever it is put out by a passing gust. Only at that thought do you notice that, today, there is no wind whatsoever on <origin>.
units.italian: Ti chiedi come possa questa candela ardere così a lungo allo scoperto, e pensi che forse i Korath la riaccendano ogni volta che una raffica la spegne. Solo a quel pensiero noti che oggi su <origin> non c'è vento di sorta.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	Seemingly only taking notice of you now, one of the younger Korath sitting by the shrine slowly rises, making her way over to you, and briefly holds up her hands with both palms facing you. She speaks quickly, and you cannot understand most of it, but you do recognize the words "humani efreti" at the end of what you guess was a question.|33|0
units.english: Seemingly only taking notice of you now, one of the younger Korath sitting by the shrine slowly rises, making her way over to you, and briefly holds up her hands with both palms facing you. She speaks quickly, and you cannot understand most of it, but you do recognize the words "humani efreti" at the end of what you guess was a question.
units.italian: Solo ora, a quanto pare, una delle Korath più giovani sedute accanto al santuario si alza lentamente, ti si avvicina e solleva brevemente le mani con le palme rivolte verso di te. Parla in fretta e non capisci quasi nulla, ma riconosci le parole "humani efreti" alla fine di quello che supponi essere una domanda.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	"What exactly is all of this?"|35|0
units.english: "What exactly is all of this?"
units.italian: "Che cosa sarebbe tutto questo, esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	(Gesture inquisitively at the shrine.)|36|0
units.english: (Gesture inquisitively at the shrine.)
units.italian: (Gesticola verso il santuario, con aria interrogativa.)

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	"Sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt. I'll be on my way."|37|0
units.english: "Sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt. I'll be on my way."
units.italian: "Scusa, non volevo interrompere. Me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	Either due to somehow having understood your meaning, or simply having correctly guessed the reason for your curiosity, the Korath begins to attempt to explain the gathering. She grabs some of the crayon-like objects and beckons you a little closer to the wall, where she begins to draw many spiral arms in white, converging in what looks like a large maw at the center. She repeatedly jabs the crayon at a point close to the center, then at you, then at herself. "<origin>," she says.|39|0
units.english: Either due to somehow having understood your meaning, or simply having correctly guessed the reason for your curiosity, the Korath begins to attempt to explain the gathering. She grabs some of the crayon-like objects and beckons you a little closer to the wall, where she begins to draw many spiral arms in white, converging in what looks like a large maw at the center. She repeatedly jabs the crayon at a point close to the center, then at you, then at herself. "<origin>," she says.
units.italian: O per aver in qualche modo capito il tuo intento, o semplicemente per aver indovinato la ragione della tua curiosità, la Korath comincia a provare a spiegarti il raduno. Prende alcuni degli oggetti simili a pastelli e ti fa cenno di avvicinarti al muro, dove comincia a tracciare in bianco molte braccia a spirale, che convergono in quella che sembra una grande fauce al centro. Punta ripetutamente il pastello su un punto vicino al centro, poi su di te, poi su di sé. "<origin>", dice.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	She then draws on the wall with a different crayon of a light-green coloring. The green seems to make a path to another dot, closer to the maw, though she takes great care to draw something like a barrier around the position - as if shielding it from the center of her spiral map. She stares at the dot thoughtfully for a few seconds, as if in disbelief of what she had just drawn herself. "Far'en Lai," she finally says, her voice cracking slightly, still facing the dot. Then, she looks back and points directly at the burning candle. "Far'en Lai," she says again, before looking back at you.|40|0
units.english: She then draws on the wall with a different crayon of a light-green coloring. The green seems to make a path to another dot, closer to the maw, though she takes great care to draw something like a barrier around the position - as if shielding it from the center of her spiral map. She stares at the dot thoughtfully for a few seconds, as if in disbelief of what she had just drawn herself. "Far'en Lai," she finally says, her voice cracking slightly, still facing the dot. Then, she looks back and points directly at the burning candle. "Far'en Lai," she says again, before looking back at you.
units.italian: Poi disegna sul muro con un altro pastello, di colore verde chiaro. Il verde sembra tracciare un percorso verso un altro punto, più vicino alla fauce, anche se lei si premura di disegnare qualcosa come una barriera attorno alla posizione - quasi a volerla proteggere dal centro della sua mappa a spirale. Fissa il punto pensierosa per qualche secondo, come se non credesse a ciò che ha appena disegnato lei stessa. "Far'en Lai", dice infine, con la voce che le si incrina un poco, sempre rivolta al punto. Poi si volta e indica direttamente la candela accesa. "Far'en Lai", ripete, prima di guardarti di nuovo.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	Reaching in her garments, she pulls out what looks to be some form of communication device. She considers it briefly, then gestures for you to follow her back to the shrine, where she carefully places the object down onto the pile of offerings. She then looks at you, as if wondering if you would follow the gesture.|41|0
units.english: Reaching in her garments, she pulls out what looks to be some form of communication device. She considers it briefly, then gestures for you to follow her back to the shrine, where she carefully places the object down onto the pile of offerings. She then looks at you, as if wondering if you would follow the gesture.
units.italian: Frugando fra le vesti, estrae quello che sembra una sorta di dispositivo di comunicazione. Lo considera per un momento, poi ti fa cenno di seguirla fino al santuario, dove depone con cura l'oggetto sul mucchio delle offerte. Poi ti guarda, come se si chiedesse se seguirai quel gesto.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	(Offer 100 credits.)|43|0
units.english: (Offer 100 credits.)
units.italian: (Offri 100 crediti.)

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	(Offer 10,000 credits.)|47|0
units.english: (Offer 10,000 credits.)
units.italian: (Offri 10.000 crediti.)

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	(Offer 10,000,000 credits.)|51|0
units.english: (Offer 10,000,000 credits.)
units.italian: (Offri 10.000.000 crediti.)

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	(Offer a picture of my home planet.)|55|0
units.english: (Offer a picture of my home planet.)
units.italian: (Offri una fotografia del mio pianeta natale.)

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	"I'm sorry, but I have nothing to offer. Goodbye."|56|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I have nothing to offer. Goodbye."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non ho nulla da offrire. Addio."

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	You remember the picture of your hometown back in <home planet> you tend to carry around, and start searching for it. Sure enough, you find it inside your back pocket, straighten it out as best as you can, and go to add it to the pile. However, the Korath stops you, holding your arm and stretching her hand carefully as if asking for the picture. You hand it to her, and she brings it very close to her eyes. The elderly Korath who wailed before appears beside her, and she shows him the picture. He seems to stare at it for minutes on end, and you begin to wonder if you somehow offended them with your choice. Then, he hands her back the picture, and seems to nod slightly. She heads close to the shrine and places the picture at the top level, with the feather, shell, and flower. The elderly Korath faces you, looking deeply into your eyes, then raises his palms toward you, letting out a faint bark. You notice all other Korath around the shrine are doing the same. When they've all acknowledged your contribution, the Korath who drew the spiral arms comes to you again, looking thoroughly impressed.|58|0
units.english: You remember the picture of your hometown back in <home planet> you tend to carry around, and start searching for it. Sure enough, you find it inside your back pocket, straighten it out as best as you can, and go to add it to the pile. However, the Korath stops you, holding your arm and stretching her hand carefully as if asking for the picture. You hand it to her, and she brings it very close to her eyes. The elderly Korath who wailed before appears beside her, and she shows him the picture. He seems to stare at it for minutes on end, and you begin to wonder if you somehow offended them with your choice. Then, he hands her back the picture, and seems to nod slightly. She heads close to the shrine and places the picture at the top level, with the feather, shell, and flower. The elderly Korath faces you, looking deeply into your eyes, then raises his palms toward you, letting out a faint bark. You notice all other Korath around the shrine are doing the same. When they've all acknowledged your contribution, the Korath who drew the spiral arms comes to you again, looking thoroughly impressed.
units.italian: Ti ricordi della fotografia della tua città natale, su <home planet>, che sei solito portare con te, e cominci a cercarla. La trovi, come previsto, nella tasca posteriore, la distendi alla meglio e ti appresti ad aggiungerla al mucchio. La Korath però ti ferma, trattenendoti il braccio e allungando la mano con cautela, come se chiedesse la fotografia. Gliela porgi, e lei se la porta molto vicino agli occhi. Il vecchio Korath che prima aveva guaito compare accanto a lei, e lei gli mostra la fotografia. Lui sembra fissarla per minuti interi, e tu cominci a chiederti se in qualche modo li hai offesi con la tua scelta. Poi lui le restituisce la fotografia e sembra accennare un cenno del capo. Lei si avvicina al santuario e depone la fotografia al livello più alto, con la piuma, la conchiglia e il fiore. Il vecchio Korath ti sta davanti, ti guarda a fondo negli occhi, poi solleva le palme verso di te emettendo un debole latrato. Noti che tutti gli altri Korath attorno al santuario fanno lo stesso. Quando tutti hanno riconosciuto il tuo contributo, la Korath che aveva disegnato le braccia a spirale torna da te, con un'espressione profondamente ammirata.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|label|60|0
units.english: small credits
units.italian: small credits

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	You add the credit chip to the objects by the shrine, and she seems to nod approvingly before looking at you once more, seemingly satisfied with your understanding of the gesture.|63|0
units.english: You add the credit chip to the objects by the shrine, and she seems to nod approvingly before looking at you once more, seemingly satisfied with your understanding of the gesture.
units.italian: Aggiungi il chip di credito agli oggetti accanto al santuario, e lei sembra annuire con approvazione prima di guardarti ancora, apparentemente soddisfatta della tua comprensione del gesto.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|label|65|0
units.english: medium credits
units.italian: medium credits

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	You add the credit chips to the objects by the shrine, and she and a few of the other Korath seem to bow lightly to you. She turns to you once more, looking satisfied with your understanding of the gesture.|68|0
units.english: You add the credit chips to the objects by the shrine, and she and a few of the other Korath seem to bow lightly to you. She turns to you once more, looking satisfied with your understanding of the gesture.
units.italian: Aggiungi i chip di credito agli oggetti accanto al santuario, e lei e alcuni altri Korath sembrano inchinarsi leggermente a te. Lei si rivolge di nuovo a te, soddisfatta della tua comprensione del gesto.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|label|70|0
units.english: large credits
units.italian: large credits

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	You attempt to carefully place the credit chips onto the pile of objects by the shrine, but despite your efforts a few end up slipping out and dropping down rather noisily. The Korath, however, seem in shock rather than disturbed at your addition. Many of them raise their hands up, their palms to you in greeting or in thanks. You look back at the Korath who drew the spiral arms, who seems to be beaming.|73|0
units.english: You attempt to carefully place the credit chips onto the pile of objects by the shrine, but despite your efforts a few end up slipping out and dropping down rather noisily. The Korath, however, seem in shock rather than disturbed at your addition. Many of them raise their hands up, their palms to you in greeting or in thanks. You look back at the Korath who drew the spiral arms, who seems to be beaming.
units.italian: Cerchi di deporre con cura i chip di credito sul mucchio di oggetti accanto al santuario, ma nonostante gli sforzi un paio scivolano fuori e cadono con un rumore piuttosto forte. I Korath, però, sembrano sconvolti più che infastiditi dalla tua aggiunta. Molti sollevano le mani, con le palme verso di te, in saluto o in ringraziamento. Guardi di nuovo la Korath che aveva disegnato le braccia a spirale: sembra raggiante.

units.id: mission:Korath Far'en Lai Prayer|	She raises her hands up towards you again, as if bidding you farewell, as you head away from the shrine. You notice many of the Korath around the spaceport take a few glances at you, but still seem focused entirely on the shrine regardless of what activity they may be performing.|75|0
units.english: She raises her hands up towards you again, as if bidding you farewell, as you head away from the shrine. You notice many of the Korath around the spaceport take a few glances at you, but still seem focused entirely on the shrine regardless of what activity they may be performing.
units.italian: Lei solleva di nuovo le mani verso di te, come per un congedo, mentre ti allontani dal santuario. Noti che molti Korath dello spazioporto ti lanciano qualche occhiata, ma sembrano comunque del tutto concentrati sul santuario, qualunque attività stiano svolgendo.
